#compdef mnema
# zsh completion for mnema, generated by `mnema completion zsh`.
#
# For this shell, now:
#     source <(mnema completion zsh)
# For every shell, once:
#     mnema completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_mnema"
#
# It completes verbs, subcommands, option names, and the values of an option whose
# declaration enumerates them, each with what its own help says. It never runs
# mnema to answer a Tab.

_mnema_commands() {
  case "$1" in
    '') echo 'init task decision skill memory observe handoff link run status focus resume next-actions guard search show timeline accountability antipatterns exposure refs rules skills usage brief key tail switch verify mcp repl completion help' ;;
    'task') echo 'move' ;;
    'decision') echo 'move supersede' ;;
    'skill') echo 'move export' ;;
    'run') echo 'start end help' ;;
    'key') echo 'restore request enroll revoke help' ;;
    'tail') echo 'list prune help' ;;
    'switch') echo 'off on' ;;
  esac
}

_mnema_described() {
  case "$1" in
    '') printf '%s\n' \
      'init:establish a mnema project in the current directory' \
      'task:create a task in the current project' \
      'decision:record a decision in the current project' \
      'skill:propose a reusable skill in the current project' \
      'memory:capture a memory in the current project' \
      'observe:record an observation about an entity in the current project' \
      'handoff:record a handoff on a task in the current project' \
      'link:link one piece of knowledge to another in the current project' \
      'run:open and close the session an agent works inside' \
      'status:show where things stand: the work, what governs, what awaits a ruling' \
      'focus:show an actor'\''s open runs (what they are touching now)' \
      'resume:show where an actor left off (their latest run, open or ended)' \
      'next-actions:show the moves the workflow allows a task next' \
      'guard:dry-run the gate: would a move be allowed on a task, and if not, why?' \
      'search:find what has been recorded, or list the most recent (no term)' \
      'show:show one whole record by id (the body a search only pointed at)' \
      'timeline:show an entity'\''s history across the trees (subject, about, target)' \
      'accountability:show who authorized what across the record (optionally windowed/filtered)' \
      'antipatterns:show recurring shapes in the record (reopens, supersessions, deprecations)' \
      'exposure:show which records hold something shaped like a credential (never the value)' \
      'refs:show what an entity is connected to across the trees' \
      'rules:show which recorded rules govern a path, and which address nothing' \
      'skills:show where each pattern came from (who proposed it, who adopted it)' \
      'usage:what each run cost, read from this machine'\''s Claude Code transcripts' \
      'brief:print what governs the work here as markdown, for an agent to read' \
      'key:manage this machine'\''s signing keys' \
      'tail:authorize a cut in the record'\''s own tails' \
      'switch:turn off, or back on, what mnema hands to a model unasked' \
      'verify:verify this project'\''s record — its committed tree and its private one' \
      'mcp:run the mnema MCP server over stdio (for an agent host)' \
      'repl:open an interactive session that reads this project' \
      'completion:print the tab-completion script for a shell' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'task') printf '%s\n' \
      'move:move a task through the workflow (follows the task; takes no --scope)' ;;
    'decision') printf '%s\n' \
      'move:accept or reject a decision (follows the decision; takes no --scope)' \
      'supersede:supersede a decision with a later one (follows the decision; takes no --scope)' ;;
    'skill') printf '%s\n' \
      'move:move a skill through the workflow (follows the skill; takes no --scope)' \
      'export:write an adopted pattern as the SKILL.md an agent host reads (records nothing)' ;;
    'run') printf '%s\n' \
      'start:open a session for an agent (facts written in it are pinned to it)' \
      'end:close a session (by default the one MNEMA_RUN names)' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'key') printf '%s\n' \
      'restore:restore this machine'\''s identity from a copy of a key'\''s private half' \
      'request:ask to bring this machine into an identity (run this on the joining machine)' \
      'enroll:vouch for a requesting key so it joins this identity (run this on a member)' \
      'revoke:retire a key from this identity, from this point forward' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'tail') printf '%s\n' \
      'list:list the tails the record holds here, with the id `prune` takes' \
      'prune:record that one whole tail was authorized to be cut (it removes nothing)' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'switch') printf '%s\n' \
      'off:stop a channel handing the record to a model unasked' \
      'on:let a channel hand the record to a model again' ;;
  esac
}

_mnema_flags() {
  case "$1" in
    '') echo '-V --version --color -h --help' ;;
    'init') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'task') echo '--scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'task move') echo '--reason --note --feedback -h --help --scope --which -V --version --color' ;;
    'decision') echo '--alternatives --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'decision move') echo '--note -h --help --alternatives --scope --which -V --version --color' ;;
    'decision supersede') echo '--reason -h --help --alternatives --scope --which -V --version --color' ;;
    'skill') echo '--body --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'skill move') echo '--note --reason -h --help --body --scope --which -V --version --color' ;;
    'skill export') echo '--out --description -h --help --body --scope --which -V --version --color' ;;
    'memory') echo '--scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'observe') echo '--topic --text --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'handoff') echo '--scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'link') echo '--rel --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'run') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'run start') echo '--which --goal -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'run end') echo '--which --outcome -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'status') echo '--actor --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'focus') echo '--actor --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'resume') echo '--actor --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'next-actions') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'guard') echo '--actor --reason --note --feedback --which --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'search') echo '--kind --scope --state --from --to --limit --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'show') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'timeline') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'accountability') echo '--from --to --who --which --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'antipatterns') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'exposure') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'refs') echo '--direction --depth --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'rules') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'skills') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'usage') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'brief') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key restore') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key request') echo '--anchor --key -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key enroll') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key revoke') echo '--reason -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'tail') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'tail list') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'tail prune') echo '--reason --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'switch') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'switch off') echo '--reason --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'switch on') echo '--reason --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'verify') echo '--global --workspace --allow-no-record --require -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'mcp') echo '--project -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'repl') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'completion') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
  esac
}

_mnema_values() {
  case "$1" in
    ':--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'init:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'task:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'task:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'task move:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'task move:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'task move:') echo 'submit start block unblock submit_review request_changes approve complete cancel reopen' ;;
    'decision:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'decision:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'decision move:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'decision move:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'decision move:') echo 'accept reject' ;;
    'decision supersede:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'decision supersede:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'skill:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'skill:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'skill move:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'skill move:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'skill move:') echo 'review adopt reject deprecate' ;;
    'skill export:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'skill export:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'memory:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'memory:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'observe:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'observe:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'handoff:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'handoff:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'link:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'link:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'run:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'run start:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'run end:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'status:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'focus:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'resume:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'next-actions:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'guard:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'guard:') echo 'submit start block unblock submit_review request_changes approve complete cancel reopen' ;;
    'search:--kind') echo 'memory observation decision task skill' ;;
    'search:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'search:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'show:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'timeline:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'accountability:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'antipatterns:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'exposure:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'refs:--direction') echo 'both out in' ;;
    'refs:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'rules:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'skills:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'usage:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'brief:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'key:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'key restore:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'key request:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'key enroll:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'key revoke:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'tail:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'tail list:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'tail prune:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'switch:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'switch off:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'switch off:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'switch off:') echo 'brief-document edit-rules-push' ;;
    'switch on:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'switch on:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'switch on:') echo 'brief-document edit-rules-push' ;;
    'verify:--require') echo 'chained signed witnessed' ;;
    'verify:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'mcp:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'repl:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'completion:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'completion:') echo 'bash zsh fish' ;;
  esac
}

_mnema() {
  local prev='' path='' word='' text='' i=2
  local -a described offered
  # Where on the tree the line already is.
  while [ "$i" -lt "$CURRENT" ]; do
    word="${words[$i]}"
    i=$((i + 1))
    case "$word" in
      -*) continue ;;
    esac
    case " $(_mnema_commands "$path") " in
      *" $word "*)
        if [ -z "$path" ]; then path="$word"; else path="$path $word"; fi
        ;;
    esac
  done
  if [ "$CURRENT" -gt 1 ]; then
    prev="${words[$((CURRENT - 1))]}"
  fi
  # A flag whose values the declaration enumerates answers alone.
  text="$(_mnema_values "$path:$prev")"
  if [ -n "$text" ]; then
    compadd -- ${=text}
    return
  fi
  text="$(_mnema_described "$path")"
  if [ -n "$text" ]; then
    described=( ${(f)text} )
    _describe -t commands 'command' described
  fi
  text="$(_mnema_flags "$path") $(_mnema_values "$path:")"
  offered=( ${=text} )
  if [ ${#offered} -gt 0 ]; then
    compadd -- $offered
  fi
}

compdef _mnema mnema
